problems.formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.CoefficientMapMatrix.actualFMatrix_det_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n) :
    (actualFMatrix n).det ≠ 0:= by sorry

problems.theorem_title: The actual selected rational multiplier has row inverse coordinates
problems.formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.CoefficientMapMatrix.selectedIntegerMultiplier_coordinates_product (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Even n) (b a : ℤ) :
    polynomialCoordinates (selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a) =
      selectedIntegerPair b a ᵥ* (selectionMatrix * (actualFMatrix n)⁻¹):= by sorry

problems.theorem_title: The selected integer output has its genuine sum and absolute convergence
problems.formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.CoefficientMapMatrix.selectedIntegerMultiplier_actual_HasSum_and_absolute (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Even n) (b a : ℤ) :
    HasSum (fun t : ℕ => (CoefficientMap.weightedR n (selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a)
      ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ))
        ((b : ℝ) + (a : ℝ) * CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 9) ∧
    Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖(CoefficientMap.weightedR n (selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a)
      ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ)‖):= by sorry
